head_commit.message:
feat(tui): display model and reasoning level in footer

Show the currently selected model name and reasoning effort level in
the TUI footer, providing users with immediate visibility into their
active configuration without needing to open the model picker.

Format: `<model> · <effort> reasoning · <context> · ? for shortcuts`
Example: `gpt-5.1-codex-max · medium reasoning · 72% context left · ? for shortcuts`

Key behaviors:
- Updates immediately when model/reasoning changes via /model
- Derives effective reasoning from model defaults when not explicitly set
- Never displays "default" - always shows actual level (minimal, low,
  medium, high, extra high)
- Models without reasoning support show only the model name
- Dot separator between model and reasoning for visual clarity

Implementation:
- Extend FooterProps with model/reasoning_effort fields
- Add setter chain: ChatWidget → BottomPane → ChatComposer → FooterProps
- Compute effective effort using model_family.default_reasoning_effort
  as fallback when explicit effort is None

Signed-off-by: Ash Shilkin <Web3Zero@54231.anonaddy.com>
